title: Mixed Event — An Ode for the Pure of Heart — Episode1 A Sudden Substitution

meta.Event: An Ode for the Pure of Heart
meta.Event Outline: Toya suddenly ends up taking on a role as a wedding flash mob extra. But when he arrives at the venue, unexpected circumstances mean that the director is nowhere to be seen. As the possibility of a canceled show grows greater by the second, Toya meets Rui...

rows.Line: se_event_bridal_2021_002
Wedding Ceremony Hall

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: So this is the venue...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Toya, you're serious about this...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I am. It'll be my first time performing in a place like this, so I want to give it everything I have.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Dude, I get that you like being a nice guy and all, but you didn't have to agree to something like this...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: No, I take that back. You would've said yes no matter what...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I was kinda looking forward to taking a breather at MEIKO's place once we were done with morning practice too...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (He just had to ask Toya to do this...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright, let's take a break here.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Okay. I'm getting thirsty too, so I think I'll go buy something to drink.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Then, you wanna head over to SEKAI?
MEIKO said that she'd be adding stuff to her menu and there's something I want to try too.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yeah, you're right...
Pancakes with extra whipped cream, right...? It might be a little too much for me...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Hm? My phone's ringing...
Oh, it's Saki...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Saki? Who's that?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Tsukasa's younger sister.
I have a feeling it has to do with the thing I was talking about...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh, right. You mentioned something about going to her Doll Festival party the other day too.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But it's rare for her to call me directly. I wonder what's going on...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Hello, this is Aoyagi.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
<T-Toya?! Thank goodness...
I got a hold of you...!>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Is something the matter?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: <I actually need to sort of ask you a favor...>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: A favor?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: <If you have time that is...>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I was hoping that you'd be able to fill in for Tsukasa at work for him...!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
<At work...?
You mean at Phoenix Wonderland...?>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Uh, no! Not that!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Tsukasa works as an extra whenever Phoenix Wonderland is closed. He said that he has to be able to work wherever if he wants to become a star...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And today's one of those days, but Tsukasa isn't feeling all that well...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: He isn't? Is he okay?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: <Yeah, he is. The doctor even said that it's just a little tummy ache. But he still says it hurts pretty bad, so I've been telling him to take the day off...>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: <He wouldn't listen and tried to go anyway. He said that a star can't let something like this get in the way of work.>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Tsukasa does take his obligations rather seriously...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: <Yeah, but he's hunched over by the door right now because of how much his stomach hurts...!>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: <I even called his temp agency, and they said it'll be no issue as long as they have a replacement, so I was hoping that Tsukasa would agree to take the day off once I did find someone...>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: <I know this is really sudden and I'll understand completely if you say no!>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But who else would you call for this...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
<I'm not sure...
It has to be a male cast member, but I don't have that many guy friends...>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: <I tried calling Tsukasa's friend from his troupe, but I couldn't get a hold of him...>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: <No...! Tsukasa, you can't go...! I'm looking for a replacement right now...!>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
What's up, Toya?
Something going on?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Sorry, Akito.
There's something I have to do.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I'll do it.
I'll be his replacement.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What?! You will?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Thank you so much, Toya!
You're the biggest lifesaver ever!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: <It's okay. Tsukasa's always been there for me so...>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Uh, Toya...
What did you mean when you said “replacement” just now?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Also, I thought I heard “his” name just now...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'll be replacing Tsukasa as an extra today.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Huh?
You're gonna be an extra?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: More importantly, why are you the one that has to do this?!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: He's not feeling well it seems, and Saki just asked me to go in his place.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: He's helped me so many times in the past, so I'd like to repay him somehow.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But you've never done any acting before. You really think you can be an extra?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That is true. I don't have much acting experience, but I'd like to give it my best shot...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Your best shot...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: <Toya, are you still there...? Tsukasa just said that he'll pay you back later...!>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Understood. Please give him my regards as well.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: <I will! I'll have him send you everything about where to go and what to do!>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Okay.
Thank you, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Dude...

rows.Speaker: PlaceInfo
rows.Line: Wedding Ceremony Hall

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I apologize for agreeing to do this on a practice day, Akito. I promise to make up for it later.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It's fine. I know that you won't budge even if I asked you not to do this...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Thanks.
I'll be going then...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
But him acting...?
As an extra for a wedding too...
Kamiyama Street

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That should be enough resistors, plus any extras I may need. Oh, I should buy more crimp connectors while I'm at it...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Whoa! That's awesome!>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <It's so cool how you're using stuff like this as props, Rui...!>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hehe. Do you like it?
Would you like to make some as well, Len?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<Me? Really? Yeah!
I wanna make a rocket that can fling you into the sky!>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Of course. Let's make one together.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: While we're at it, why don't we make it so that you can fly with it?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Me, flying? Like Tsukasa...?>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes. I'm sure it'll be quite an experience.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (Although Tsukasa does always scream his head off when that does happen...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'll head over to SEKAI so we can get started. Len, I'll need my phone for this, so if you don't mind... Oh?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I've missed quite a few calls. I may've been a little too absorbed with my shopping.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: They're from... Tsukasa's sister and Tsukasa...? Oh, speak of the devil...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hello... You sound like you're at death's doorstep, but this is you, yes, Tsukasa? How can I help?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Being an extra...?
Oh, you mentioned that before.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Aoyagi's going in your place?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
In that case, please take care.
You should get some well-deserved rest for a change.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Is Tsukasa okay?>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: He was scheduled to be an extra for something today but he unfortunately has a stomachache.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: His younger sister, Saki, asked his friend, Aoyagi, to fill in for him instead...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But Aoyagi doesn't have much acting experience and he became somewhat worried.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: He asked me to go and take a look to see if he needs any help or if they need more people on site.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<Oh, okay...
Are you gonna go, Rui?>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Tsukasa said that it was up to me and based on my interactions with Aoyagi during the School Festival, he seemed like a good kid.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: On top of that, they have staff on site to help with any actual acting and direction, so I imagine he'll be just fine...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: By the way, Len, have you ever been to a wedding...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <What? A wedding?>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <I've only read about them in scripts and stuff, but I've never actually seen or been to one before. Why do you ask...?>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Then it's settled.
Let's go together, Len.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'm sure it'll serve as a good reference for your own shows as well.
